label: Root links from Isaac Newton, Philosophiae naturalis principia mathematica
summary: Axiomata, Lex I: Corpus omne perseverare in statu suo quiescendi vel movendi uniformiter in directum, nisi quatenus a viribus impressis cogitur statum illum mutare: Newton describes uniform rectilinear motion as a state retained unless impressed forces change it. To bear on the target, the state/transition distinction must track being moved in the specified respect. The law's form does not supply an actual force-free body or rule out sustaining causes of being.
